comment: The text characterises sovereign models as "hosted and governed within national or regional control," treating hosting location and governance authority as a single choice. It is possible to separate hosting for countries with limited domestic compute. At the same time, hosting domestically does not guarantee sovereignty if models remain externally controlled.

anchor.note: p.109 l.183-186 read as the printed page; section 5.4.4 agrees

public.text: The text characterises sovereign models as "hosted and governed within national or regional control," treating hosting location and governance authority as a single choice. It is possible to separate hosting for countries with limited domestic compute. At the same time, hosting domestically does not guarantee sovereignty if models remain externally controlled.
public.suggestedRevision: Distinguish data and model residency from sovereignty, and note that pooled or regional compute arrangements are a third option alongside domestic hosting and single-provider dependence.
